Homeowner questions
Do you handle design, permits and construction?

We coordinate planning, construction details and applicable permit requirements based on the agreed project scope.

Can you build over an existing patio or deck?

Sometimes. The existing structure, footings, drainage and code requirements must be evaluated before recommending reuse.

How long does a project take?

Timing depends on design, approvals, material availability, project complexity and weather. A more specific schedule is provided after the scope is defined.

What decking and finish materials do you use?

Material selections may include TimberTech and other composite or PVC decking, PVC trim and column wraps, V-groove or tongue-and-groove ceilings, asphalt or standing-seam roofing and natural bluestone.

Our story

A builder-led company for projects that demand coordination.

Woodsmith Construction is a Bucks County-based construction company specializing in luxury outdoor living and select residential construction.

Led by owner and builder Pete Buechle, our team focuses on projects where planning, structural knowledge, craftsmanship and communication all matter. From the first site conversation through the final walkthrough, clients have a clear point of responsibility.

We are licensed in Pennsylvania and New Jersey and serve homeowners throughout Bucks County and surrounding areas.

More than one trade

The advantage of complete project thinking.

Outdoor-living projects often cross the boundaries between excavation, masonry, carpentry, roofing and finish work.

Instead of treating those pieces as unrelated tasks, Woodsmith considers how they perform together. That means thinking about elevations before framing, drainage before hardscaping, roof tie-ins before finishes and access before work begins.

Before you build

Common planning questions

Every property is different. These answers provide a useful starting point before an on-site evaluation.

What is the difference between dry-laid and wet-laid bluestone?

Dry-laid stone is installed over a compacted aggregate base, while wet-laid stone is mortared to a concrete base. Site conditions, desired appearance, drainage and budget influence the right system.

Can you add a roof over my existing deck?

Possibly. The deck structure and footings must be evaluated for the additional loads and current code requirements.

Do you handle drainage as part of the project?

When drainage affects the project, we incorporate appropriate grading and water-management work into the proposed scope.

Can you coordinate multiple parts of one backyard project?

Yes. Coordinating excavation, structure, hardscape and finish work is a central part of our design-build approach.
